disclosure: The SF1 admission was inspected. This SF10 stage tests scale amplification and may not be represented as an untouched optimizer holdout.

candidate_pruning.rule: Retain fused and the two non-dominated SF1 contenders; permanently remove the materially dominated Q3 post-Join candidate and the lower-ranked Q10 post-lineitem candidate.

stop_rule: If Q3 and Q10 do not produce two different confidence-authorized singleton winners, stop TPC-H optimizer expansion permanently and retain TPC-H only as semantic and method evidence.
scientific_boundary: Passing supports stable query-dependent plan-cost evidence at SF10. It does not by itself prove that an optimizer predicts the winner.
